scenes.title: Where to find an OKX code
scenes.sub: Three normal places, one quick check

lines.show: A valid OKX referral code comes from someone who already has an OKX account.
But people still make mistakes when they look for one.
First, never pay for a code or send anyone a deposit to get one.
Three other mistakes come up a lot.
Clicking unknown links instead of typing the code yourself.
Copying from a blurry screenshot and mixing up letters.
Trying to add the code after the account is already made.
Get a code from a friend or a creator you follow.
Type it in the referral field on the sign-up screen.
The app usually flags a code that doesn't exist.
Want one to try? The code is XOACPQFC.
Type it exactly, letter by letter.

scenes.title: If OKX is available where you live

lines.show: If OKX is available where you live, use code XOACPQFC when you create your account.
